nodes.name: Personio Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives Person.updated webhook from Personio when employee status changes. Configure this URL in Personio: Settings > API > Webhooks

nodes.name: Status = Onboarding?
nodes.notes: Only proceed if the employee status changed to 'onboarding' (contract signed)

nodes.name: Personio Auth
nodes.notes: Authenticate with Personio API to get bearer token

nodes.name: GET Employee Details
nodes.notes: Fetch full employee profile: name, email, department, office, hire_date, custom attributes. Make sure all needed attributes are whitelisted in Personio API credentials.

nodes.name: Office = Munich?
nodes.notes: PILOT: Only process Munich employees. For other offices, route to manual notification (future expansion). IMPORTANT: Check the exact value of 'office' in your Personio (could be 'München', 'Munich', 'DE-MUC', etc.)

nodes.name: Calculate Onboarding Date
nodes.notes: Calculates next available onboarding date (1st or 15th). If the date falls on a weekend, it shifts to Monday. Returns structured employee + onboarding data for downstream nodes.

nodes.name: Send Welcome Email
nodes.notes: Sends welcome email to the new employee's private email. UPDATE: Customize the HTML template, add CC recipients (from Personio 'access' section), and attach the onboarding agenda PDF.

nodes.name: Notify IT - Equipment Setup
nodes.notes: Sends structured notification to IT Munich with all details needed to prepare equipment. UPDATE: Replace IT_MUNICH_EMAIL env var with actual IT group email.

nodes.name: Create Outlook Event
nodes.notes: Creates calendar event in Outlook for the onboarding day. Sends invite to the new employee + HR + IT attendees. UPDATE: Add HR and IT attendees to the 'attendees' array. Reminder set to 24h before.

nodes.name: Other Offices (Future)
nodes.notes: PLACEHOLDER: For non-Munich offices. Currently just logs. Future: add office-specific branches with local IT contacts, onboarding dates, and localized email templates.

nodes.name: Notify HRBP (Manual)
nodes.notes: Fallback: notifies HRBP when the office is not yet automated. This ensures no onboarding is missed even for non-Munich offices.
